cli.network_send.still_starting.role: CLI send refusal after a cold runtime has not published within the ready deadline
cli.network_send.still_starting.tone: factual and direct; explicitly negate queueing, do not imply any future delivery
cli.network_send.still_starting.note: {session_id} is the conversation ID and {peer} is the owning device name or ID; preserve both verbatim. The command returns without writing a message or scheduling a retry. Preserve the strong negation of NOT queued; uppercase is not required in scripts that do not use it. No final period.
